scenarios.description: A customer with multiple completed orders should have their order amounts summed and order count calculated.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The customer's name and region should be standardized to upper case, and the total order amount should be 350.00 with an order count of 2.
scenarios.title: Standard processing of completed orders

scenarios.description: Orders that are not completed should not be included in the aggregation.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The order should be filtered out and not included in the aggregation.
scenarios.title: Filter out non-completed orders

scenarios.description: An order with a null status should be excluded from the aggregation.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The order should be excluded from the aggregation due to null status.
scenarios.title: Handling null order status

scenarios.description: Test the maximum precision for order amount.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The order amount should be processed correctly without precision loss.
scenarios.title: Boundary test for order amount precision

scenarios.description: Ensure that duplicate orders for the same customer are aggregated correctly.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The duplicate order should be aggregated correctly, resulting in a total order amount of 200.00 and an order count of 2.
scenarios.title: Duplicate handling in aggregation
